work.permit: Light work listed by Ministerial Agreement No. 4677 of 2023 (no individual permit)

note: Read 2026-11-03. Work: the Labour Law No. 43/NA of 24 December 2013 (Amended), art. 101, read first in the unofficial English translation the ASEAN Secretariat publishes and then, the same day, in the Lao text on the Official Gazette (laoofficialgazette.gov.la, published 14 October 2014, status current), a scan read from its page image: employers may take on workers from fourteen to eighteen, without overtime, and where necessary from twelve to fourteen in light work, the light work set out in a separate list. That list is the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare's Agreement No. 4677 of 12 December 2023 on light and hazardous work for young workers, published in the Gazette on 10 July 2026 (in force on publication, the Gazette's listing says, under art. 108 of the Law on Making Legislation): its art. 5 item 1.3 names officially organised contests, television and radio programmes and artistic and literary performances among the light work a person of twelve to fourteen may do. So the form holds work from fourteen and a younger performer allowed from twelve in that light work, with no permit named. Until the Agreement was read the file held performers below fourteen barred (a reading of art. 101 alone); the ASEAN translation is no longer cited. Majority: null; the Civil Code (2018) wasn't read (the blocker papers.ages.blocked.LA holds the attempts). Service: not read (the game doesn't read service).

sources.title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍແຮງງານ (ສະບັບປັບປຸງ), No. 43/NA of 24 December 2013, published in the Official Gazette 14 October 2014 (Official Gazette of the Lao PDR, laoofficialgazette.gov.la, display&id=667), art. 101, p. 36 of the scan; read from the page image, checked against tesseract (lao)
sources.said: ມາດຕາ 101(ປັບປຸງ) ການຮັບເອົາຜູ້ອອກແຮງງານໄວໜຸ່ມ ຜູ້ໃຊ້ແຮງງານ ສາມາດຮັບເອົາຜູ້ອອກແຮງງານ ທີ່ມີອາຍຸ ຕໍ່າກວ່າ ສິບແປດປີ ແຕ່ບໍ່ໃຫ້ຫຼຸດ ສິບສີ່ປີ ເຂົ້າເຮັດວຽກໄດ້ ແຕ່ບໍ່ໃຫ້ເຮັດວຽກເພີ່ມໂມງ. ໃນກໍລະນີຈຳເປັນ ຜູ້ໃຊ້ແຮງງານ ສາມາດຮັບເອົາ ແລະ ນຳໃຊ້ຜູ້ອອກແຮງງານທີ່ມີອາຍຸ ຕໍ່າກວ່າ ສິບສີ່ ປີ ແຕ່ບໍ່ໃຫ້ຫຼຸດ ສິບສອງ ປີ ເຂົ້າເຮັດວຽກໄດ້ ແຕ່ຕ້ອງຮັບປະກັນວ່າວຽກທີ່ໃຫ້ເຮັດນັ້ນ ເປັນວຽກເບົາ ... ວຽກເບົາ ໄດ້ກຳນົດໄວ້ໃນສາລະບານຕ່າງຫາກ.

sources.title: ຂໍ້ຕົກລົງວ່າດ້ວຍ ການກຳນົດວຽກເບົາ ແລະ ວຽກທີ່ເປັນອັນຕະລາຍ ສຳລັບແຮງງານໄວໜຸ່ມ, Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare Agreement No. 4677 of 12 December 2023, published in the Official Gazette 10 July 2026 (laoofficialgazette.gov.la, display&id=2602), art. 5; read from the page image, checked against tesseract (lao)
sources.said: ມາດຕາ 5 ປະເພດວຽກເບົາ ປະເພດວຽກເບົາທີ່ອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ນຳໃຊ້ແຮງງານ ທີ່ມີອາຍຸ 14 ປີ ແຕ່ບໍ່ຫຼຸດ 12 ປີ ມີດັ່ງນີ້: 1. ຂົງເຂດບໍລິການ ... 1.3. ວຽກປະເພດເກມການແຂ່ງຂັນທີ່ຈັດຂຶ້ນຢ່າງເປັນທາງການລວມທັງລາຍການທາງໂທລະພາບ, ວິທະຍຸ, ການສະແດງສິນລະປະວັນນະຄະດີ;
